description: Use this when a user wants a week of training built around their goal, a specific split, or their current session frequency. Returns a day-by-day week with session length, blocks, intensity, what to track, and the rules for adjusting if the week goes sideways. Do NOT use for injury rehabilitation, post-surgical programming, or return-from-injury plans — those need a clinician. Do not use to prescribe a program for a condition the user has disclosed. Use fitness.assess_performance_profile first when you have not yet seen the user's training history, because the plan adapts to it.

goal.description: The primary outcome to build the week around.

notes.description: Optional context the user gave: time constraints, injuries to work around, schedule, preferences.

sessionsAre.description: 'established' = consistent for 1+ years; 'rebuilding' = consistent for months but capacity is down; 'returning' = after a long layoff.

sessionsPerWeek.description: How many training sessions per week to program (1-6).

name: fitness.build_training_microcycle
